headline: Public hearings on projects at 417 & 421 Cambridge Street, 195 Mill Street, and three other addresses.
summary: The agenda also lists site plans for 23 Everton Avenue, 18 Crown Street, and 29 Firglade Street. It includes three approval not required plans and board policy and communications items.
items: Old business: 23 Everton Avenue (PB-2026-083), public meeting on definitive site plan
New business: 18 Crown Street (PB-2026-039), public meeting on definitive site plan
29 Firglade Street, Firglade Street ROW, & Tihonet Street ROW (PB-2026-057), public meeting on definitive site plan
29 Firglade Street and related streets (PB-2026-057), public meeting on MGL 81-G and/or GRO Ch. 12, §12, private street improvement
18-20 Crompton Street (PB-2026-068), public meeting on definitive site plan
18-20 Crompton Street, public hearing on special permit (IZ) for relief from parking, loading, and landscaping requirements (Article VII, Section 6.A.ii)
20-22 Goldthwaite Road (PB-2026-078), public meeting on definitive site plan
20-22 Goldthwaite Road, public hearing on special permit (IZ) for relief from parking, loading, and landscaping requirements (Article VII, Section 6.A.ii)
25 Gates Lane (PB-2026-086), public hearing on accessory dwelling unit special permit to modify dimensional requirements (Article IV, Section 8.G.5)
195 Mill Street (PB-2026-089), public meeting on definitive site plan
195 Mill Street, public hearing on more than one building on a lot
417 & 421 Cambridge Street (PB-2026-090), public hearing on definitive 'frontage' subdivision plan
Approval not required plans: AN-2026-049 (0 Myrick Avenue, private), AN-2026-052 (264 Grafton Street, public), AN-2026-053 (129 Blackstone River Road, public)
